decisions: Headline kept as 'Michael Fassbender: "I Hope Humanity Has Changed"', a straight rendering of the Hebrew quote headline.
Established English titles used: 12 Years a Slave, Hunger, Shame, X-Men: First Class, 300, Inglourious Basterds.
'שחקן הבית של מקווין' rendered 'McQueen's go-to leading man' (not 'in-house actor').
'חשף את אבר מינו ב"בושה"' rendered 'going full frontal in Shame', the magazine idiom for the same fact; 'הוריד ממשקלו' rendered 'dropping the weight'.
'אם כבר הורדת מגננות' rendered 'Speaking of dropping your guard', picking up 'drop your guard' from the preceding quote as the Hebrew picks up 'מגננות'.
'לשמור על העוגה ולאכול אותה' rendered with the standard idiom 'having my cake and eating it too'.
The whip answer's 'כמו ש... אני' rendered 'The same way Chiwetel practiced the violin, I practiced the whip', keeping the two-beat comparison.

Long Hebrew sentences split only where English needed it: the first paragraph (two sentences in both), the 'human element' answer (the sentence about the whippers' damaged souls stands alone), and Epps's 'He's the same. He's just reacting to his fears.'
lostInTranslation: Nothing of substance; the piece has no puns or Israeli references. 'תרפיה' and 'ביזנס' are transliterated English in the Hebrew and simply become English.
